name: com.haruchanz64.unity-auth-core
description: Backend-agnostic authentication, account lifecycle, and typed REST API framework for Unity 6 with single-flight 401 refresh, pluggable IAuthBackendAdapter, Unity Multiplayer connection approval validation, UI Toolkit console, OpenAPI 3.0 spec, and an optional Dockerized reference server.

samples.description: Starter IAuthBackendAdapter implementations showing how to connect UnityAuthCore to Supabase, Firebase, or custom backends.
Examples wiring MultiplayerAuthBridge into Netcode for GameObjects, Mirror, and FishNet connection approval.
